items.title: Bonus Hollander POTD Cedric Maxwell. Cornbread was 12th pick by BOS in 77 from UNC-CHA. Peaked at 19 ppg & led NBA in FG% 2x. Scored less after Bird came but was key contributor & 81 Finals MVP. Traded to LAC in 85 but his knee wore out & retired by 88. Now does TV work.
